title: Ghost and Asset
author: Noor Nystrom
blurb: Jude Coldharbour, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
